Verify Location Names Using the Collaborative Australian Protected Areas Database

Source: R/locationName_verification_CAPAD.R
locationName_verification_CAPAD.Rd

This function verifies whether a set of coordinates intersects with the Collaborative Australian Protected Areas Database (CAPAD) 2022 terrestrial layer bundled with the package (capad) and assigns the corresponding protected area's name. For coordinates that do not match any protected area, the nearest protected area is used instead.

Usage

locationName_verification_CAPAD(dep)

Arguments

dep

A dataframe containing coordinates (in latitude and longitude), and a unique identifier for each sampling location.

Value

A dataframe with the original columns and two additional columns:

  • CAPADlocationName: The name of the protected area assigned to each coordinate. Names are formatted to replace spaces with underscores.

  • CAPADminDistance: The distance (in meters) to the nearest protected area, for coordinates outside every protected area; zero for coordinates inside one. Only added when at least one coordinate falls outside every protected area.

Details

The function performs the following steps:

  1. Loads the bundled CAPAD layer and standardizes its column names.

  2. Converts the input dataframe dep into a spatial object using latitude and longitude.

  3. Determines the intersection of the coordinates with the CAPAD layer.

  4. For coordinates with no match, finds the nearest protected area (distance in metres) and prints out warning messages if the updated location name is far from the original coordinate (1-5 km, 5-10 km, >10 km).

  5. Returns the modified dataframe with a new column CAPADlocationName containing the matched or nearest protected area's name.

Author

Tom Bruce & Zachary Amir

Examples

# two cameras of the Woomargama project shipped with WildObsR
dp <- example_datapackages("NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010")[[1]]
dep <- frictionless::read_resource(dp, "deployments")
dep <- dep[c(1, 40), c("deploymentID", "latitude", "longitude", "locationName")]

# the protected area each camera is in, beside the recorded locationName; both are
# inside Woomargama National Park, so no CAPADminDistance column is added
updated_dep <- locationName_verification_CAPAD(dep)
updated_dep[, c("deploymentID", "locationName", "CAPADlocationName")]
#>                    deploymentID  locationName CAPADlocationName
#> 1 10_WildObsID_0010_2021_a_Cam1 Woomargama_NP     Woomargama_NP
#> 2 18_WildObsID_0010_2021_a_Cam1 Woomargama_NP     Woomargama_NP
